column2: Hello, little Spirit Mage.⏎My name is Shannon.⏎I am traveling all across Celtland.⏎▼⏎It seems you are about to set out on a⏎journey too. Perhaps we will meet again⏎somewhere.
I heard talk of you on my travels.⏎It seems you are no ordinary Spirit Mage.

You're the Spirit Mage I saw in Impaness.⏎I'm surprised you reached Darlam so⏎quickly!⏎▼⏎But you can go no farther than this.⏎They say a bandit has appeared in the⏎forest near this town, and he has closed⏎the road through to Lake Lenos.⏎▼⏎What a nuisance. I wanted to go to Lake⏎Lenos too...
How surprising. That is the Earth Orb.⏎Legend says only the true Spiritcaller⏎can draw out its power.
Beyond this lake lies Lalapool, City of⏎Water. In the merchant nation of Angulus,⏎it is as lovely as the castle town of⏎Rideen.

We meet again, little Spirit Mage.⏎Did you come to this town too because⏎the ferry isn't running?⏎▼⏎I don't really know the cause, but perhaps⏎some evil power is at work on the spirits.⏎▼⏎Past Windward Forest to the south lies⏎Haliel, the Wind Town. And this is⏎Lalapool, City of Water.⏎▼⏎Perhaps you will find some clue⏎in those two towns.
I have heard that whoever gathers all⏎four Spirit Gems will gain tremendous⏎power.⏎▼⏎But only the true Spiritcaller can draw⏎that power out, they say.

So you've come to Haliel too.⏎Windward Forest lies next to this town,⏎and I have a bad feeling about it.⏎▼⏎The Wind Spirit is restless as well.⏎When you enter the forest, you had better⏎be very careful.
Little Spirit Mage, have you noticed?⏎The stirring of the spirits has quieted⏎a little.⏎▼⏎But somewhere else, a far greater power⏎seems to be on the move.

What a splendid town Rideen is.⏎So beautiful, so grand...⏎▼⏎How strange, though. Human lives are⏎such fleeting things. So why build a town⏎that people could live in for a thousand⏎years?⏎▼⏎...I cannot understand it.

Spirit Mage, have you seen what has⏎become of this town? It is the work of⏎King Geas of Blanick.⏎▼⏎He gained great power, and just to test⏎it, he burned the town to the ground and⏎made its people suffer.⏎▼⏎Why do people destroy the very things⏎they worked so hard to build?⏎...I cannot understand it.
So you have finally gathered all four⏎Spirit Gems. If you are the true⏎Spiritcaller, you should be able to draw⏎out their power.⏎▼⏎Your father seems to have already set⏎out for Blanick Castle.
Ah, Jean-Jacques. Little Spirit Mage.⏎Your father... in his battle with⏎King Geas...⏎▼⏎Only you can stop that man now.⏎Please, Jean-Jacques, do something!!

Jean-Jacques. You have been chosen...⏎by the One...⏎▼⏎Just as I expected, you have grown strong.⏎Solvaring, Zelse, Nepty, Fargo...⏎and Geas too. I lent my power to them all.⏎▼⏎So that by defeating them, you would grow⏎strong enough to use the Spirit Gems.⏎▼⏎You now have power enough to open the⏎way to the place where the One awaits!⏎▼⏎Now, here is the Book of Ether.⏎Take it to the Stone Circle ahead.⏎There you will learn the truth⏎of your journey.
Go on now, Jean-Jacques.⏎Go and learn the truth...⏎It is your destiny.

Jean-Jacques. It has been a long journey.⏎I have lived only to guide you here...⏎▼⏎...and here my role comes to an end.⏎▼⏎Strange, isn't it? The One and I were both⏎born of you humans. Yes... born of the⏎ugliness in human hearts.⏎▼⏎And yet you humans tried to make use even⏎of beings like us -- again, out of the⏎ugliness in your hearts.⏎▼⏎But by absorbing that ugliness, the One⏎grew mighty -- a being whose heart holds⏎nothing but destruction.⏎▼⏎That is why we needed Ether. We needed⏎a reason to live, as you humans do.⏎▼⏎Come now, the One awaits you.⏎▼⏎If you are truly one chosen by the⏎spirits, the true Spiritcaller, then the⏎monsters will vanish from this world, and⏎peace will come again.

What am I doing here?⏎Keeping watch in case monsters come in⏎from the sea. Lord Bart, the town's⏎protector, is away, you see.⏎▼⏎Now there's a splendid Spiritcaller.⏎I hope you'll soon be just like him too,⏎Jean-Jacques.
Impaness is blessed by the spirits, so⏎I bet there are spirits hiding somewhere⏎around here.⏎▼⏎But looking for them is way too much⏎bother. Not for me, no thanks.

I'm a traveler, journeying all across⏎Celtland.⏎▼⏎I'm from Rideen, actually. Impaness is⏎the northernmost town in Celtland, so⏎getting here was quite a trek.⏎▼⏎Impaness is a fine town too, but Rideen⏎has the finest castle in all the land.

Lately I hear monsters have multiplied⏎along the highway, and a bandit has⏎appeared in the forest. What can it mean?⏎How frightening.⏎▼⏎Ever since Lord Bart left on his journey,⏎it's been nothing but this.

Your father, Lord Bart, is loved by⏎everyone in town. I've never met a finer⏎man.⏎▼⏎The people of the Sanctum seldom come into⏎town, but Lord Bart walks the streets and⏎looks out for everyone's safety.
Hey! When I grow up, do you think I can⏎be a Spiritcaller like you?
I'm a pirate, I am!⏎All the treasure in the world is mine!⏎I ain't scared of monsters neither!
Guess what! There's a great big scary⏎rabbit hopping around outside town!
Jean-Jacques, I'll tell you a neat trick!⏎▼⏎While you hold down the B Button, the⏎camera moves behind you, so it's easier⏎to see!
Hey, hey! Did your daddy say you could⏎go play outside?⏎▼⏎My mommy said it's dangerous outside⏎'cause it's full of monsters.⏎Aren't you scaaared?

This is a tale from long, long ago.⏎They say a certain book brought a terrible⏎calamity upon Celtland.⏎▼⏎Green lands turned to desert in a single⏎night, and the towns that flourished there⏎vanished, so they say.⏎▼⏎The lesson being that men must not wield⏎what lies beyond human understanding.
Baaa~
Baaaa~
Was my grandchild out playing happily?⏎▼⏎Thanks to the Sanctum's warding magic,⏎we old folk can live in peace.⏎We are truly grateful for it.
Tired, little Spirit Mage?⏎Why not rest a while at our inn?⏎I'll record your journey in the register⏎for you, too.⏎▼⏎Will you be staying the night?{F2}

Setting out on a journey, are you?⏎Then I'll give you some White Wings.⏎▼⏎Use them, and you can return to Impaness⏎any time you like.⏎▼⏎But there's one condition for using⏎the Wings.⏎▼⏎The Wings can only be used in open places,⏎like plains and towns.
Oh, looks like you already have White⏎Wings. I'll give you some another time.
Billy and Frank keep playing even after⏎dark. I wish they'd take after you, young⏎Spirit Mage.

A traveler? How unusual,⏎with how dangerous it's become everywhere⏎of late. .........Hm?⏎▼⏎You seem to carry a rare fate, unlike any⏎I have ever seen... one an ordinary person⏎could scarcely bear...⏎▼⏎An old man like me can't see it clearly,⏎but it seems this journey of yours will⏎carve out the path of that fate.

Oh, is that not a Spirit Gem?⏎As the Gems come together, it may lead to⏎evil or to good. Tread with care.⏎▼⏎Let me give you a word of advice.⏎To move water, first move the wind.⏎That will open a new path for you.
This road leads to the town of Darlam⏎and Jeanbat Forest. But they say there's⏎a bandit in that forest.⏎▼⏎A child like you had best not go in there⏎carelessly.
I heard!⏎A child like you, defeating that bandit!⏎You'll be a splendid Spiritcaller before⏎long, mark my words!

Spirits are hiding all over the place.⏎Try walking into every corner of towns,⏎fields and caves!⏎▼⏎And when you win a fight, the spirits⏎lend you their power.⏎▼⏎You're strong, Jean-Jacques, so you'll⏎be fine!

When you want to open a treasure chest,⏎go right up to it. When the '!' mark⏎appears, press the Z Button.⏎▼⏎Inside are items that'll help you on your⏎journey. There are some in the Sanctum⏎too, so go look for them.

Jean-Jacques, if you're heading out on⏎a journey, let me teach you how to fight.⏎▼⏎When you meet monsters, a large circle⏎forms around you. That is the⏎battle circle.⏎▼⏎Inside the battle circle, another, smaller⏎circle appears. That one is for moving,⏎and it's called the movement circle.⏎▼⏎You can move freely inside the movement⏎circle, but once you cast magic, strike⏎an enemy with your staff, or use an item,⏎you can no longer move.⏎▼⏎Of course, you can also move outside the⏎battle circle. If you choose an action⏎while outside it, you escape the battle.⏎▼⏎When things get dangerous, sometimes you⏎need to run!
Take care out there, Jean-Jacques.⏎Here, some Mint Leaves. You can't go on⏎a long journey without them. Take them!
Come back when you run out of Mint⏎Leaves. I'll give you more anytime.

O spirits, watch over this young one.⏎Grant him a guiding light on the path⏎he walks...⏎▼⏎All we can do is pray, but we shall pray⏎for your safety until the day you return.⏎▼⏎In Bart's last letter, he wrote that he⏎would cross Lake Lenos to Lalapool.⏎▼⏎I understand you are worried about Bart,⏎but do not do anything reckless.

Leave the Sanctum and travel from the⏎town of Impaness to the town of Darlam.⏎▼⏎I shall ask the King of Darlam to lend⏎you his aid.⏎▼⏎Mark me: I will not allow you to treat⏎your own life lightly.⏎Return safely to the Sanctum.

There are four Spirit Gems in Celtland.⏎They are said to be needed to quell the⏎calamity brought about by the Book of⏎Ether.⏎▼⏎Yet in all this time, only one person has⏎ever held all four: a great Spiritcaller,⏎a thousand years ago.⏎▼⏎That you now hold one of them is a⏎matter of great importance.⏎Never let it go.
So you're setting off, Jean-Jacques?⏎Everyone at the Sanctum has been worried⏎about you, so you'd better have a word⏎with them before you go.

Jean-Jacques, did you know? Spirits⏎hide in all sorts of places. When you get⏎close, a '?' mark appears. Press the⏎Z Button there.⏎▼⏎Four spirit marks will appear. Press⏎whichever C Button matches the spirit⏎you want.⏎▼⏎Then that spirit will lend you its power,⏎strengthening that element.⏎▼⏎Of the four C Buttons, Fire is C-Up,⏎Water is C-Down, Earth is C-Left and Wind⏎is C-Right!
Neighhh!

Hey, have you heard?⏎A bandit's set up in Jeanbat Forest, and⏎he stole a precious treasure from the⏎castle, too!⏎▼⏎What an outrage. If even the castle⏎soldiers couldn't stop him, he must be⏎one huge brute!
They say the bandit's gone, but who on⏎earth beat him? Even a whole band of⏎soldiers couldn't take him.⏎▼⏎Must've been one enormous fellow.
Blast it! That rotten bandit!⏎Thanks to him rampaging in the forest,⏎I can't get any work done!⏎▼⏎The castle soldiers are useless.⏎Fine, I'll take him down myself!
Blast it! That rotten bandit!⏎Got himself beaten before I could get to⏎him. Wasn't so tough after all, was he?
*hic* I'm a... clay digger, see...⏎*hic* But right now... *hic*⏎I'm takin' a day off!⏎▼⏎*hic* Every now 'n' then... a man needs⏎a rest... *hic* Right, lad... *hic*
*hic* They say the bandit's been beat...⏎Now I can... *hic* get back to work⏎with peace o' mind... *hic* yessir.⏎▼⏎*hic* Dunno who it was... but here's to⏎whoever beat 'im! Cheers!
I'm a potter, but thanks to that bandit⏎I can't get any good clay. At this rate⏎I can't make good pottery.
The tricky part of pottery is getting⏎the fire just right. Only when the Fire⏎Spirit and the Earth Spirit work together⏎can you make fine pottery.
Do you know about Princess Flora?⏎She's very lovely, but brave too.⏎▼⏎In this bandit business, I hear she was⏎the first to try to go after him, and the⏎King was beside himself!

My husband's a clay digger.⏎He digs up some pretty good clay, but⏎then that bandit showed up, didn't he?⏎▼⏎So now he won't do a lick of work.⏎If he's got nothing to do, he could at⏎least help me clean the house!
So they finally got rid of that bandit,⏎did they? Took 'em long enough, I'll say.
Oh my, what a cute Spirit Mage!⏎Let me treat you to a drink, sweetie.⏎Here you go, Morning Dew!
Oh, you already have Morning Dew? And⏎here I was going to treat you.⏎Next time, then!
Even the King is struggling with the⏎bandit in the forest, they say. He could⏎attack the town any time. I'm so worried⏎I can't let my daughter play outside...
The bandit seems to be gone. Thank⏎goodness! Now my daughter can go out to⏎play again. Children should play outside,⏎after all.
Daddy and Mommy say I can't go out⏎and play. 'Cause a bannit is out there⏎and it's dangerous.⏎▼⏎But what's a bannit?
Guess what! The bannit is gone!⏎They said I can go out and play.⏎Yaaay!⏎▼⏎But what's a bannit?

Have you heard about the bandit of⏎Jeanbat? He snuck into the castle,⏎struck down the soldiers and stole the⏎treasure.⏎▼⏎That treasure is called the Earth Orb, you⏎see. Legend has it that it quelled the⏎calamity that once befell Celtland.
I hear the bandit in the forest has been⏎dealt with. By the way, young one, do⏎you know what became of the castle's⏎treasure?
You're a Spirit Mage of Melrode, eh?⏎A long journey alone must be hard.⏎Here, take these Yellow Wings.⏎▼⏎Oh, and don't forget: you can't use⏎the Wings in caves or forests.⏎
Oh, looks like you already have Yellow⏎Wings. Come back when you run out, then.
Welcome to Darlam, the Earth Town!⏎Won't you stay the night?{F2}
I crossed Lake Lenos to come buy pottery⏎in this town.⏎▼⏎But then a bandit showed up in the forest,⏎and now I can't get back to Lake Lenos.⏎What a fix to be in...
The forest is open again. Now I can go⏎home whenever I like, so I think I'll⏎take it easy here a while longer.
Welcome to the Darlam tavern!⏎You look hungry, lad.⏎▼⏎Here, have some Honey Bread. Food's the⏎most important thing on a journey.
I'll give you Honey Bread anytime.⏎Come back when you run out.
Welcome to Darlam Castle.⏎You must be the Spirit Mage from Melrode.⏎▼⏎King Glen Scottfort awaits you⏎in the throne room.

Welcome, Spirit Mage. The envoy of the⏎Spirit Hierarch has told me your story.⏎You set out after Sir Bart, who went in⏎search of the Book of Ether, I hear.⏎▼⏎The loss of the Book of Ether is a grave⏎matter for this kingdom as well. That book⏎must never be loosed upon the world.⏎▼⏎But even now, a crisis grips this castle.⏎A bandit stole the castle's Earth Orb,⏎and on top of that he has sealed off the⏎road to Lake Lenos.⏎▼⏎I sent soldiers into the forest, but they⏎were no match at all. He uses some strange⏎magic, and it has us at our wits' end.⏎▼⏎By rights I should lend you soldiers,⏎but I have already lost too many.⏎Somehow, that bandit must be stopped.

That a child like you could defeat that⏎bandit... I am astonished. Just as the⏎Spirit Hierarch said, you are no ordinary⏎child.⏎▼⏎I entrust the Earth Orb to you. It is a⏎treasure only a Spiritcaller can wield.⏎It may help you in your search for Bart.⏎▼⏎As a small token of thanks, I have opened⏎the hidden door behind the throne. Take⏎whatever you wish from the treasury⏎beyond.
Welcome, Spirit Mage. The Spirit⏎Hierarch's envoy told us you would be⏎coming.

A bandit broke into the castle the other⏎day. We figured he was only one man, but⏎then he hit us with some fearsome magic.⏎▼⏎Everyone who got close was cut down.⏎Maybe we should have kept our distance⏎and worn him down a little at a time...⏎▼⏎A kid like you would get sent flying by⏎one punch from him. Not that you'd be⏎crazy enough to try something like that.
You're the one who beat the bandit?⏎Really? Spiritcallers must have⏎incredible power.
Beyond lies the throne room. You must be⏎the Spirit Mage the Sanctum sent word of.⏎Please, go on through.
A bandit got in just recently, so we're⏎checking everyone who comes to the castle⏎very carefully.⏎▼⏎Though I expect someone from the Sanctum⏎is nothing to worry about.
That's the Earth Orb...!⏎Don't tell me you defeated that bandit!⏎I can't believe it!
The Spirit Hierarch has told us why you⏎have come. But right now the castle faces⏎a grave crisis.⏎▼⏎Whatever it takes, we must recover the⏎stolen Earth Orb.
You defeated the bandit for us!⏎Until now, I believed no power could⏎surpass a knight's sword.⏎▼⏎I never knew magic could be so mighty.⏎You've earned my respect.
My goodness, Spirit Mage!⏎This is Princess Flora's chamber.⏎If His Majesty catches you here, there'll⏎be a dreadful fuss!

Walking in without even a greeting--⏎isn't that ruder than the bandit? But⏎I like you. You're a Spiritcaller, aren't⏎you?⏎▼⏎Has anyone told you about the bandit?⏎He's taken over an old, abandoned fort,⏎and runs wild as if he owns the place.⏎▼⏎If you have the courage, would you go to⏎the forest and find out what he's up to?⏎If you can use magic, that would be a⏎great comfort.⏎▼⏎The townspeople and the castle soldiers⏎are all living in fear...⏎Please, I beg you, lend us your strength.

Thank you for protecting Darlam and⏎everyone in it. You're just a child, yet⏎you have such wonderful power!⏎▼⏎I can't believe you're just an ordinary⏎Spiritcaller. I can't quite say why,⏎but I can feel it.
Welcome to the lakeside inn.⏎Will you be staying the night?{F2}
I love Lake Lenos, you see.⏎I often stay at this inn.⏎▼⏎I've never seen it myself, but they say⏎there's an island in the middle of Lake⏎Lenos. Have you ever seen it?
Don't take what old man Griyon down the⏎road says too seriously. You never know⏎whether any of it is true.
Don't think I've seen you before.⏎On a journey, are you? I can't imagine⏎setting out on a dangerous trip like that.⏎In town, the monsters never attack you.

I did a lot of traveling in my youth.⏎▼⏎I heard all sorts of tales on the road,⏎but the most terrifying of all, without a⏎doubt, was the tale of the Day of⏎Calamity.⏎▼⏎Long ago, the nations warred over a book⏎that held immense magical power. The war⏎dragged on for decades, until at last one⏎nation emerged victorious.⏎▼⏎That nation finally used the book's power.⏎But in the next instant the heavens tore,⏎light from the sky swallowed the land, and⏎the nation fell in a single day, they say.⏎▼⏎That day is called the Day of Calamity.⏎But they say a great Spiritcaller⏎quelled that power.
Ever heard of a place called Crystal⏎Valley? They say it's beautiful as a⏎dream, and that many spirits dwell there.⏎▼⏎I'd love to see such a lovely valley⏎just once... But no one knows⏎where it is.
There's a Spiritcaller in this town,⏎Lady Leila. Thanks to her warding magic,⏎we're able to live here safely.
Lalapool is called the City of Water.⏎Rideen is splendid too, but Lalapool⏎is the best!
I'm having my Prim take singing lessons.⏎I want her to be the finest singer in all⏎Celtland.

'...When the guarding waters recede...⏎la la la... the path to Crystal Valley...⏎lu lu lu... shall open... la la la...'⏎▼⏎I'm practicing my song.⏎When I grow up, I want to sing in front⏎of the prince at Rideen Castle.

This town, y'see, was built long, long⏎ago by a single Spiritcaller.⏎▼⏎When that Spiritcaller dug a well here,⏎water came welling up fit to overflow,⏎and so Lalapool, the town of water, was⏎born.⏎▼⏎The well that Spiritcaller dug is called⏎the Crystal Well, and anyone who looks⏎upon it is put under a curse.⏎▼⏎Hmm? Or did I get that wrong...

I am Leila. I am the one who protects⏎this town. I have been awaiting you.⏎▼⏎Are you aware that the winds have stopped⏎in this land? The cause lies near Haliel,⏎the Wind Town.⏎▼⏎This world is made of the four spirits.⏎If any one of them grows too strong, or⏎wanes, the balance is lost.⏎▼⏎And if the balance is lost, no one can⏎say what may happen. Please, Spirit Mage,⏎lend us your strength.

Spirit Mage, the wind has returned.⏎Thank you. You truly are the one Lady⏎Epona spoke of...⏎▼⏎Besides protecting this town, I also⏎serve as a messenger who conveys the words⏎of Lady Epona of Crystal Valley.⏎▼⏎Lady Epona is a mysterious person. She⏎has the power to see all things; there is⏎nothing she does not know.⏎▼⏎Lady Epona awaits you in the valley.⏎She says there is something she wishes⏎to tell you.⏎▼⏎Outside the inn is the room of the⏎Crystal Well. When you are ready, please⏎come to the well. I will guide you to⏎Lady Epona.

I have been expecting you. Let us draw⏎back the guarding waters and open the way⏎to the sacred Crystal Valley. When the⏎waters recede, a cave mouth will appear.⏎▼⏎The cave is long and teems with monsters,⏎but you must make it through. It is how⏎we will know if you are the true⏎Spiritcaller.⏎▼⏎Lady Epona awaits you in the valley.⏎Now, make haste. The waters stay drawn⏎back for only a short while.⏎▼⏎May the spirits bless your journey...
It is our duty to aid you on your⏎journey.⏎▼⏎Though our help is small beside the⏎weight of the destiny you bear...
I ran away from Grinos.⏎All alone... leaving everyone behind.⏎▼⏎What's become of that town now, I wonder?⏎Oh, Mother...
You're crossing Lake Lenos? A kid like⏎you, out traveling with real courage...⏎▼⏎Then how can I not go back?⏎Someday I'll go back, I swear it.⏎Back to my mother, no matter what...
So, young man, you're on a journey.⏎Then you'll need some Blue Wings.⏎Here, take them.⏎▼⏎Oh...⏎▼⏎Remember, the Wings can't be used in⏎caves or forests. Don't forget.
Aw, what, kid? Here I was going to give⏎you some Blue Wings. Guess you've already⏎got them.
Hey there, lad. This inn doubles⏎as a tavern. Stay the night if you like.{F2}
Tee-hee, you're on a dangerous journey,⏎aren't you, sweetie? Here, have some⏎refreshing Mint Leaves.
Tee-hee, you already have Mint Leaves,⏎I see, sweetie. When they run out, come⏎back here. I'll pick some just for you.

That lot outside seem to be searching for⏎something, but I wish they'd clear out of⏎here, and quick.⏎▼⏎Honestly, I can't make head or tail of⏎what young folk think these days.⏎That Spiritcaller who came to town the⏎other day.........⏎▼⏎Zelse, I think he called himself. A⏎Spiritcaller, and he didn't even greet us.⏎His sort will never be loved by spirits.⏎▼⏎A Spiritcaller, above all, must be⏎loved by the spirits.⏎▼⏎To be loved by the spirits, you must do⏎good deeds and cherish nature. Even the⏎monsters attacking you were once spirits.⏎▼⏎Free the spirits dwelling in monsters, and⏎they'll become your allies. For that, you⏎must grow strong and train hard.⏎▼⏎......⏎▼⏎By the way, what's your best magic?⏎In my day, they called me Mais the⏎Watercaller.⏎▼⏎My name rang out across all Celtland.⏎Impressive, eh?

That lot outside still haven't left.⏎Honestly, I won't have any peace till⏎they're gone.⏎▼⏎But you, small as you are, seem quite⏎well loved by the spirits. That's good.⏎It's what matters most for a Spiritcaller.⏎▼⏎I was the same, back in my day. After all,⏎the name of Mais the Watercaller rang out⏎across all Celtland.⏎▼⏎Mind you, when we were in our prime,⏎times were peaceful, not like now.⏎▼⏎It's up to you young folk to bring peace⏎to the world from here on. Do your best.⏎▼⏎......⏎▼⏎By the way, what's your best magic?⏎Mine's Healing. I'll teach you sometime,⏎if you like.
